case_number: 2024 INSC 192; Civil Appeal Nos 2179-2180 of 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C) Nos 4004-4005 of 2024), Civil Appeal Nos 2181-82 of 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C) Nos 4006-4007 of 2024), Civil Appeal No 2183 of 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C) No 1031 of 2024), Civil Appeal Nos 2184-85 of 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C) Nos 4008-4009 of 2024), Civil Appeal No 2186 of 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C) No 4010 of 2024)

parties.respondent: High Court of Punjab and Haryana & Ors

summary: Appointment of Additional District and Sessions Judges through 65% promotional quota; interpretation of Haryana Superior Judicial Service Rules 2007; eligibility criteria for promotion: 50% aggregate vs 50% individual marks requirement in written test and viva voce; conflict between Rules and High Court resolutions; constitutional validity of administrative resolutions; Articles 233, 234, 235; scope of High Court's administrative powers; impugned High Court judgment from December 20, 2023; Supreme Court examining whether resolution requiring 50% individually in each component violates Rules requiring only 50% aggregate.
final_judgment: Permission to file Special Leave Petitions granted; Leave granted; matter remanded for further consideration in light of correct interpretation of Rules regarding 50% marks requirement.
